results.method: docker build on test VM (ubuntu@192.168.1.41) — recorded in /tmp/s0f6866-build/build4.log (uncompressed size from docker images)

anonymous_pull_verified_on_vm.result: Status: Downloaded newer image (anonymous, no login)

ac_2_3_resolution.lxd_protocol_note: LXD 5.21.4 LTS (the version on the test VM) does NOT support the `oci` remote protocol — only `lxd` and `simplestreams` are accepted by `lxc remote add --protocol`. The AC's literal `lxc launch docker:ghcr.io/...` syntax requires LXD 6.x or Incus, both of which add OCI registry support. The image-registry-layer behavior (public pull, image integrity, CLI presence) is identical whether verified via `docker pull` (used here) or `lxc launch docker:...` (would work on LXD 6.x). When palmux's lxd-container runtime needs to consume this image directly, the current path is `docker pull` + `docker save` + `lxc image import`; a follow-up Phase B/C task may bump the LXD floor to 6.x to simplify.

size_measurements.build_1: OOM-killed at claude install (no swap, 2 GB RAM)
size_measurements.build_2_original_dockerfile: 2.26 GB (target ≤ 1 GB) — Layer 2 with ansible+ansible-lint+build-essential+pip+venv = 1.04 GB alone
trim_decisions: ansible → ansible-core (saved ~250 MB; full ansible only adds optional collections, devs `pip install ansible` if needed)
drop ansible-lint (saved ~200 MB; lints belong on dev host CI, not runtime)
drop build-essential (saved ~350 MB; devs install on demand for native ext compile)
drop python3-pip + python3-venv (saved ~80 MB; explicit install if needed)
